rv.q: Such is the depth and sensitivity of her performance that it feels as though the real Eleanor Roosevelt is standing before us.
Even the familiar stories are fascinating, thanks to St. Germaine's vivid script and Plum's skillful portrayal of a multitude of characters.
Eleanor is a fascinating, educational, inspiring and enriching biographical memory play helmed by Paula Plum's tremendous performance as Eleanor.
This isn't the kind of play I would typically see, but I'm glad I did.
'Eleanor' is one of those plays where the subject is too epic to be told so intimately.
